data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/apis.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/apis.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Permissive on per-endpoint value shapes; runtime validator (manifest_validator.py + TS mirror) handles per-field semantics. Tightens in Phase 9 when per-file TS types feed the generator (spec 60.3 D3.5).
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0

title: Spec 60 — apis.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS apis.yaml file after the _meta block is stripped. The apis key is required (may be an empty map for browser-DOM-only integrations).

apis.description: Map of API endpoint name → endpoint definition. May be empty when the integration is browser-DOM only (e.g. gmail today).
